name: one-home-per-subject
label: one home per subject
comment: A subject carries rdf:type in more than one home graph. Every reader that joins within one graph silently sees half the subject (the 2026-08-14 /effective 404 class). Violators found at authoring: pulse, clearing, borg, werk.

name: edge-follows-node
label: edge follows node
comment: An outgoing edge asserted in a graph where its subject carries no typing — the edge lives outside the node's home, so a home-graph walk cannot see it. Co-location (gate.enforced) is the special case where node-home equals property-home; this check encodes the general rule.

name: step-implemented
label: automated-stream steps name their implementation
comment: A step in an automated stream (athena, werk) without implementedBy. Proven red 2026-08-15 against the live store: 15 rows (all 6 athena + all 9 werk steps). This check flipping GREEN is #3896's acceptance proof — found-15-then, now-0.

name: hat-layer-matches-attachment
label: a hat attaches only at its own layer
comment: a hat attaches only at its own layer

name: appointment-has-anchor
label: a per-product hat has an anchor
comment: a per-product hat has an anchor

name: appointed-hat-is-declared
label: a hat is a declared row, never a free string
comment: a hat is a declared row, never a free string

name: appointee-is-the-owner
label: an appointment never contradicts ownedBy

name: layer-never-points-up
label: a dependency never points to a higher layer
comment: A domain, or a service a domain hosts, depends on a domain in a higher-ranked layer. The foundation may lean only on the foundation; the service clause is Kade's: without it a foundation service that needs a capability domain would pass.

name: no-runtime-edge-into-build
label: nothing depends on the build layer at runtime
comment: Every domain is generated and shipped with the build layer (the model, werk); none may need it running. A dependsOn edge into it from outside it is the ADR-061 violation: the graph read at runtime.

name: domain-has-a-layer
label: every domain sits in a layer
comment: A domain with no layer says nothing and so passes both rules above (Kade: the hollow gate). warn while the other teams' domains take their layer on their own cards; becomes block, and DomainShape inLayer minCount 1, when this returns 0 live.

name: pre-mint-names
label: rows named before the mint table (debt, counting down)
comment: Each row is a Gate, Property, PropertyKey or EmitContract whose IRI predates ADR-040's <kind>-slug convention (19 live on 2026-09-25: 4 gates, 8 properties, 6 property keys, 1 emit contract; #4324 added the 28 API surfaces named surface-*, which the seed had refused since 09-20). The seed accepts exactly these by name (pre-mint-names.txt); renaming one removes its line and stages its retirement. warn, never block: it measures debt, it does not refuse.

name: qual-no-compiled-artifacts-in-src
label: qual-no-compiled-artifacts-in-src
comment: No compiled .js, .js.map or .d.ts files under any src/ directory (DEC-2209).

name: qual-stdout-to-loki-no-log-files
label: qual-stdout-to-loki-no-log-files
comment: No *.log files in the repo; services log to stdout through Loki (ADR-023, DEC-114).

name: code-domain-api-over-raw-fuseki
label: code-domain-api-over-raw-fuseki
comment: Application code calls domain doors, not Fuseki :3030 directly (DEC-093, ADR-048).

name: arch-localhost-internal-binds
label: arch-localhost-internal-binds
comment: Internal daemons bind 127.0.0.1, never 0.0.0.0 (ADR-012, ADR-042, ADR-019).
